title: Not every voice quoting God was sent by Him.
paragraphs: Not every voice quoting God was sent by Him.

Jesus warned that false prophets would rise and deceive many.
They would sound spiritual.
They would quote Scripture.
They would gather crowds.
But truth is not proven by popularity.

“Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.”
— Matthew 7:15

Some voices comfort sin instead of confronting it.
Some preach blessing but never repentance.
Some build platforms instead of pointing people to Christ.

The danger isn’t that false prophets look evil.
The danger is that they look convincing.

Discernment is not optional in the last days.
It is a responsibility for every believer.

⚠️ Test every message.
📖 Return to Scripture.
🔥 Stay awake.

Question:
What is the clearest sign that a teacher is truly from God?
Many false teachings sound good at first.
What do you think is the biggest warning sign of a false prophet today?

• No repentance message
• Twisting Scripture
• Chasing fame and money
• Something else?
